requirement: Official data 2003-2022; 2023-2025 null until another explicitly labeled version selected
Missing values must remain null; zero is not allowed to represent missing
Preserve USD million at current prices; no silent conversions
Series must be all January 2026 revision; never merge earlier 2023/2025 vintages silently
Identify official aggregate total-economy activity from data structure; do not sum aggregates together with constituent sectors
Reference economy is value-added origin (or exporter for exports), counterpart is final demand absorber or export destination as appropriate
Do not add FFD_DVA to EXGR_DVA; overlapping representations of value added
Location of value-added production is not identity of final profit beneficiary or citizenship of shareholder
SGP VA in Indonesian demand and IDN VA in Singapore demand are different directional measures and need not be equal
Approximate 2018 bar chart readings may be used only as context; never inserted into revised 2025 dataset
Foreign VA in SG exports to IDN is from all non-SG economies, not specifically Indonesia
Trade in value-added final demand is not equivalent to direct exports or bilateral services surplus
Key shape, total activity aggregate code, and observation values must be validated on actual CSV before publishing
